directPayment.channel: QR ad-hoc with mandatory credit card

scope: Official SWE price sheet valid from 1 April 2026. Ad-hoc is a distinct tariff for customers without an account, activated from the QR code at the charging station and paid by credit card.
policy: Keep SWE e-laden customer prices and roaming prices separate from the direct ad-hoc CPO tariff. Do not propagate this tariff to other e-laden member CPOs without operator-specific proof.
